395:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

395:t_1:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Then the $$サイデリアル$$ operating in the $$残されの海$$ won't be coming after the $$ガルガンティア船団$$?」

395:t_1:5.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「They seem to be clashing with pirates and such in the area, but as you know, this fleet's strength must seem negligible to them.」

395:t_1:6.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「So as long as we don't actively get in their way, I take it they intend to leave us alone.」

395:t_1:9.en:
$$リジット$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ seem to be conducting some sort of survey underwater, but their activity is affecting our fishing.」

395:t_1:10.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「The bounty of the sea is our livelihood... If this goes on, our way of life will eventually become unsustainable.」

395:t_1:11.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「That is why some in the fleet are saying we should surrender to the $$サイデリアル$$ and have them guarantee our safety and livelihood.」

395:t_1:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I understand how you feel, but...」

395:t_1:13.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I know what you mean, Captain $$ジェフリー$$. It is not only the fleet's strength they consider negligible, but probably our lives as well.」

395:t_1:14.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Bowing to them may secure us a moment's safety, but it means living in fear of their shadow from then on.」

395:t_1:15.en:
$$リジット$$
「...If we hadn't been caught up in this so-called spacetime transfer, we could have gone on with our lives...」

395:t_1:16.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I don't think so, $$リジット$$.」

395:t_1:18.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Nothing in this world is unchanging. Wherever we were, the life of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ would have changed someday.」

395:t_1:19.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Then, as members of this world now, we should accept change and live on within it.」

395:t_1:20.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As someone also caught up in the $$時空震動$$, I take the liberty of endorsing the Fleet Commander's words.」

395:t_1:21.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... You learned that too, through meeting $$レド$$ and $c.」

395:t_1:22.en:
$$リジット$$
「But sudden change and the many problems that come with it will take a toll on your health, Fleet Commander.」

395:t_1:23.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Is something wrong with the Fleet Commander's health?」

395:t_1:24.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「At this age, a chronic ailment or two comes with the territory.」

395:t_1:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「With things like that, if opinion within the fleet splits...」

395:t_1:26.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Bringing it together is the Fleet Commander's duty.」

395:t_1:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I understand the situation. Please leave the $$サイデリアル$$ to us.」

395:t_1:29.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I appreciate it, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

395:t_1:30.en:
$$リジット$$
「But please be very careful around the $$クジライカ$$s.」

395:t_1:31.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Those are the marine creatures the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ worships, right?」

395:t_1:32.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Perhaps because of the $$サイデリアル$$'s activity, $$クジライカ$$s are showing up even at spots where they're not usually seen.」

395:t_1:33.en:
$$リジット$$
「The fleet's people consider them sacred creatures, and harming a $$クジライカ$$ is taboo.」

395:t_1:34.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood. I'll tell our personnel to be careful.」

395:t_1:35.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then, Captain... Considering the survey area may extend to the deep sea, I'll contact Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ as well.」

395:t_1:41.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$! Looks like you've been well!」

395:t_1:42.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Look who's talking! We were worried sick because we never heard from you!」

395:t_1:43.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Where on earth were you? Even if you were on $$蒼の地球$$, you could have sent at least a message.」

395:t_1:44.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well, um... We went to the center of the galaxy.」

395:t_1:46.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hold on. I'll tell you everything in order, from when we left the fleet.」

395:t_1:47.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Looks like you've been through your share of hardships, $$ピニオン$$.」

395:t_1:48.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. $c made me a whole size bigger of a man, reborn.」

395:t_1:49.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Big talk. So are you going to show me how big this man of yours is?」

395:t_1:50.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You bet! Lucky for me, I hear $c will be staying here for a while.」

395:t_1:51.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The day has finally come to put my long-planned scheme into action.」

395:t_1:52.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「A scheme? You don't mean...」

395:t_1:53.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ランド$$!」

395:t_1:54.en:
$$ランド$$
「If it's about that deal, I'm not interested.」

395:t_1:56.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm sorry. I can't use the $$ホワイトドール$$ for something like that.」

395:t_1:58.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, $$ピニオン$$. Making money off gambling isn't my style.」

395:t_1:59.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$クロウ$$'s right. Quit acting like a speculator and earn your living by the sweat of your brow.」

395:t_1:60.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Looks like it's hopeless, $$ピニオン$$.」

395:t_1:61.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn! You're all spineless! Fine, then! I've got ideas of my own!」

395:t_1:62.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Looks like $$ピニオン$$'s making a fuss over there.」

395:t_1:63.en:
$$パーラ$$
「He's just happy to be back at the fleet after so long.」

395:t_1:64.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「I'm glad $$ガロード$$ and the others look well too.」

395:t_1:65.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Seems $$ティファ$$ had it rough too. Were you okay?」

395:t_1:67.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Heh... You two are as close as ever.」

395:t_1:68.en:
$$エイミー$$
「All right! Now that the four girls of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ are together, let's dance today!」

395:t_1:69.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Hold on! Am I not counted among those four girls?」

395:t_1:70.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Well, you were the one who didn't want to make the costume, $$パーラ$$.」

395:t_1:71.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Who'd wear something that see-through and risque!」

395:t_1:73.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Is $$ティファ$$ really going to wear something like that and dance!?」

395:t_1:74.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$メルティ$$ said... $$ガロード$$ would be happy.」

395:t_1:76.en:
$$メルティ$$
「No need to thank me, $$ガロード$$. ...You come see it too, handsome over there.」

395:t_1:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Of course. All of $c are $$レド$$'s teachers.」

395:t_1:80.en:
$$メルティ$$
「If all of $c are here, that means $$アルト$$ and the others came too, right?」

395:t_1:81.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「$$メルティ$$ really does love handsome guys.」

395:t_1:82.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Well, yeah. Outsiders have started coming to the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ little by little, but...」

395:t_1:83.en:
$$メルティ$$
「When you say a gang of handsome guys, it's got to be $c!」

395:t_1:84.en:
$$アルト$$
「...$$メルティ$$ doesn't seem to understand what we're actually doing.」

395:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Don't say that. It's fine to have a place untouched by the fighting outside.」
